title: QM FFT Feature Package
description: High-performance NUFFT-based 3D analysis: k-space masking, gradient mapping, spectral metrics, batch HDF5 IO, and interactive 3D visualizations.

title: Feature Extraction Container
description: Dockerized, Snakemake-managed pipeline for ALFF/fALFF, ReHo, Hurst, fractal dimension, QM-FFT, and RSN analysis with robust docs.

title: EpiFlow
description: Epilepsy research pipeline: DICOM→BIDS (optional), fMRIPrep preprocessing, and advanced feature extraction for fMRI.

title: BrainViz DK
description: Advanced brain visualization toolkit for neuroimaging data analysis, featuring interactive 3D brain rendering and comprehensive visualization tools.

title: MT-WAN EEG Pain Estimation
description: Collaborative EEG pain-decoding pipeline combining phase-aware multi-task deep learning, classical ML baselines, subject-wise validation, and interpretable evaluation.

title: Generative Ising Model for Resting-State fMRI
description: Structure-informed Monte Carlo Ising simulations that model how brain-network architecture can give rise to functional connectivity patterns observed in resting-state fMRI.

title: Task-State EEG Classification
description: Deep-learning classification of video-watching, audio-listening, and resting EEG using CNN, RNN, LSTM, and bidirectional-LSTM models.

title: Tinnitus EEG Classification
description: EEG-based deep-learning classification for distinguishing people with tinnitus from healthy-control participants across multiple model architectures.

title: Live Market Analyzer
description: Planned research and analytics workspace for exploring live market data, signals, and interpretable visual summaries.

title: Q-NeuroBench
description: In-progress reproducible benchmark for hybrid quantum-classical machine learning on EEG and neuroimaging features, with rigorous classical baselines and interpretable evaluation.
